nodes.label: Redaction policy and placeholder categories
nodes.rationale: Keeps exported bundles publishable without losing evidentiary value: redact emails, people, orgs, secrets, hosts, home paths, repos, and proprietary terms to stable placeholders while preserving session ids, tool/skill names, line numbers, and the safe command/result/source structure needed to verify findings.

hyperedges.label: Scrubbing and audit pipeline governed by the redaction policy
